'''Life Day snowball bombs''' were fancy products sold at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] around [[3638 BBY]]. While called "bombs," those devices were completely harmless, as they were intended to generate [[Snowball (object)|snowballs]]. Those snowballs could then be thrown at unsuspecting targets, covering them with a layer of gleaming snowflakes. As such activities were considered unworthy of an Imperial citizen, the purchase and possession of Life Day snowball bombs was forbidden by the [[Imperial Edict GR-1NC4]].<ref name="Holonet">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20131216|text=IMPERIAL EDICT GR-1NC4}}</ref>
